facts.fact: AstaanConnect, the connectivity arm of Astaan, became Somalia's first official Starlink reseller, selling kits and subscriptions (from $36.9 a month residential) with local installation and support to households, businesses, schools and offices.
Starlink launched nationwide in Somalia in August 2025 following approval from the National Communications Authority, as stated by the article published 2025-09-24.

systems.tiers: households, businesses, schools, humanitarian organisations, government offices
